notes: The single finding G0275 was a weak-existence check (isinstance only). Hardened by adding independent oracle validation: urllib.parse.urlparse verifies https scheme, non-empty netloc, and non-empty path for both authorization_url and token_url; scopes tuple is checked to be non-empty with each entry non-empty; use_pkce is asserted True; provider enum identity is asserted. The documented mutation (blanking authorization_url in OAUTH_CONFIGS) would make the new assertion fail immediately. No production defects found; the OAUTH_CONFIGS entry is well-formed.
